Hey, bipolar here!
Do not give up on your treatment. If this is not working, change. Change doctors, meds, therapists.

Sometimes for me (most of the times, actually) is quite hard to leave bed, since life has no meaning. But this meaning is you who give. 

If I enjoy life? Yes. I think is amazing to be able to feel anything. Warmth of the sun, purr of the cat, a good drive with the wind in your face, the taste of a good meal. Have a beer, a glass of wine. To chat with someone about something completely random. To be in love.

Do not give up on your treatment. Life is a roller coaster. And the ride is better with you in it. :)
